terminology_decision.moment: The entries are moment-like power sums, but the Möbius coefficients are signed and the shifted 2x2 Hankel determinants are negative. Positive-moment-cone language is therefore inappropriate.
terminology_decision.Hankel: Hankel is appropriate for the surrounding determinant construction and log-concavity statements, not as a claim that the sequence has a positive representing measure.
terminology_decision.Schur: Schur quotient or rank-one Schur-complement quotient is acceptable if the defining block matrix is displayed. Schur cone is not conventional for the normalized finite positive averages proved here.
terminology_decision.convexity: Because the theorem normalizes by the sum of positive weights, its exact geometric object is the finite convex hull of the scalar quotient values, not an unnormalized cone.
terminology_decision.rank_one: Rank one describes the source construction family. The theorem does not quantify over all rank-one rational approximants or all rank-one Hankel/Padé kernels.
